about_the_game:
ChloroLink is a tiny and cozy management game, where your goal is to help Lux, a sprout of life, grow and extend its rootweave! Link flowers and mushrooms together to bloom the world back to life!

Explore the world one plant at a time 🌼✨

Whether it's the direction the plant is growing to, resources it produces, or the joy it gives to the other flowers around, each and every plant participate to your exploration and push your network's boundaries in a unique way. But every plant has its own constraints! You will need to slowly tend to your rootweave and maintain the satisfaction balance in order to awaken lost Lux's sisters.

A relaxing experience 🍃💛

No timer, no traps. In ChloroLink, you will always find various ways to explore and satisfy your sprouts in a chill and cozy environment.

Your cute pistil-ed friends have various criterias impacting their satisfaction. Watering, daylight, happy and friendly mushrooms around... By night, some plants fall asleep while others are flourishing. But the next day always come, and if some secrets will require you to pause and think, you will always have different ways to overcome difficulties.

Help the life flowers to balance the world 🌱🍄

Lux awakened, but its sisters didn't! Find them and discover what does the world has to offer. By extending and reestablishing a link between the life flowers, help Lux to grow and evolve to its final form to bloom the world back to life!

Features🖱️

What ChloroLink has to offer :

  • Cute flowers, bushes, trees and mushrooms🌻

  • A unique way to explore in which each plant has a role

  • Various biomes with their own rules

  • Golden acorns to find and collect 🌰

  • Small cute critters! 🐞

What you WILL NOT find :

  • Timers and time constraints

  • Advanced strategy

  • Multiplayer modes

  • Fast-paced action and realtime decision making

A small indy game 💚

ChloroLink bloomed from the collaboration of Flo (Laywelin), an indy game programmer, and its closest friends Nicolas (Zdieska) and Amanda (Mantelia) kindly sharing their artist's sensibilities and skills! The game was made with passion and care, and comes with the soft touch of Sacha Clerc-Renaud who produced the musics. We sincerely hope the game will make you feel like you're wrapping yourself in a warm blanket on a cold day 🍵

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512MB or Graphic Chipset
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: In ChloroLink, a cute and cozy management game, guide Lux the sprout of life as she spreads her rootweave to connect charming flowers. Use each plant’s growth pattern to explore, reinforce the links between plants, overcome gentle challenges, and help Lux bloom the world back to life!
